QuestInfo.name: Neinheart's Information
QuestInfo.0: Meet Neinheart in Ereve to discuss the Seal Stone thief.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart says his knights and the Explorers must work together against the Black Mage. He writes a letter about the Master of Disguise and gives it to you. \r\nNow it's time to meet #bClaudine#k in #bEdelstein#k.
QuestInfo.2: You have received information on the Master of Disguise from Neinheart in Ereve. Now go see Claudine in Edelstein.

0.0: Once, not too long ago, a Master of Disguise did in fact infiltrate Ereve. Why do you ask? \r\n#L0##b(You explain the entire situation to Neinheart. He seems trustworthy, right?)#l\n#k
0.1: I see. Then I must tell you, I've seen the Master of Disguise's abilities with my own eyes. His disguises are flawless, in terms of looks. Utterly perfect. If it weren't for a certain knight, I'm not sure what would have become of Ereve. \r\n#L0##bWho saved Ereve?#l\n#k
0.2: It is a lengthy story. I will write a letter to Athena Pierce explaining all that happened. There, I'm done. Take it to a member of the Explorers.

yes.0: So you are planning to head out to Edelstein? I don't know if they will be willing to help you. But I guess it won't hurt to try.
yes.1: Just don't tell them you're a knight! Ha, ha, ha. Sorry, inside joke, and it's not even funny. But make sure they know you're an Explorer, not a knight.

no.0: You can keep it for yourself if you like. It doesn't matter to me.

1.0: I'm Claudine, Edelstein's doctor. What brings you here?

yes.0: Hush! In Edelstein, the walls have ears. Speak to me in a moment.

npc.0: Not sure who to talk to in Edelstein? The town is riddled with members of the Resistance. Pretty much anyone who's not a Black Wing is part of the Resistance. Hitting up the town's #bdoctor#k should be a safe bet.
